itemdesc-groomingbrush: Hold right click on a dirty animal to brush it clean. Cleans twice as well as a wisp of dry grass, and faster. Wears out with use.
blockdesc-waterer-raw: Fire it in a pit kiln to make a waterer.
blockdesc-waterer-fired: A clay bell drinker: a wide, low dish that even chickens can reach. Fill it with a bucket; thirsty animals walk to it and drink.

water-container: drinks from a barrel or bucket ({0} L left)
water-undrinkable: no drinkable water within {0} blocks (hot spring, salt and dirty water are not drinkable)
nursing-unwell: its mother is unwell and has little milk
nursing-orphan: orphan, feed it at a trough
nursing-orphan-handfeed: orphan, does not know the trough yet: feed it by hand
interact-handfeed: Feed by hand (milk or its food)
